facts.fact: KRAY只需从巴黎打一通国际电话，就能安排下一次会面。
facts.anchor: To set up his next meeting, KRAY just has to place an international phone call from Paris.

facts.fact: KRAY在给日内瓦的VANDERROHE打电话前后都走监视检测路线（SDR），电话用的是巴黎的公共电话亭。
facts.anchor: KRAY employs Surveillance Detection Routes, SDRs, both before and after calling VANDERROHE in Geneva from one of those Parisian public telephone booths.

facts.fact: KRAY在第一趟SDR途中进了一家tabac，用现金买了一张电话卡。
facts.anchor: KRAY stops by a tabac and buys a phone card using cash.

facts.fact: 在外移动了三个小时、一路尽情打量成年女性之后，KRAY挑了一个电话亭，给VANDERROHE打电话。
facts.anchor: after three hours of moving from place to place and scoping on adult females to his heart’s content, KRAY selects a phone booth and places his call to VANDERROHE.

facts.fact: KRAY自称是Howard的朋友，问明天下午十二点半对VANDERROHE是否合适。
facts.anchor: It’s Howard’s friend. He asked me to check in and see if twelve thirty tomorrow afternoon works for you.

facts.fact: KRAY又走了两个小时的SDR，没有发现Shadows，只看到Figments和Casuals。
facts.anchor: KRAY carries out two more hours of SDR, during which he spots no Shadows, only Figments and Casuals.

facts.fact: KRAY要避开的是法国国内情报机构“Direction Centrale du Renseignement Intérieur”的雷达。
facts.anchor: the French internal service, the Direction Centrale du Renseignement Intérieur
